params.body:
Clicking a relation in Netwerk showed who it shares projects with and how many, but not how they meet. Lines in the graph said the same: "3 gedeelde projecten".

**"Werkt samen met" (the relation's panel)** now shows per relation:
- what it is on the shared projects: role plus its most frequent cost category or contact function, e.g. `Leverancier: Stortkosten`, `Contact op project: Architect`, `Klant`
- `samen op 38 projecten: P-… , P-… en 36 meer`, newest first (the full list is in the tooltip)
- who takes it over (`neemt over: …` / `nog niemand neemt over`), on its own line. Before, a long list of takers squeezed the relation's name down to one letter.

**Graph:** the hover tip on a line names what each side is for GLK: "A (klant) en B (leverancier), samen op 3 projecten". The legend line under the graph points to "Werkt samen met".

**Phone:** the panel is a grid item and now gets `min-w-0`. Without it, the longest line in the panel made the page wider than the screen.

Checked on a seeded demo DB by screenshot, desktop and phone width. The line hover tip in the canvas was not screenshotted. New test for the partner lines. Full suite 362/362, JS 22/22, pint clean. No migration.
params.title: Netwerk: say how a relation works with the ones it is linked to
